title: WMF forecast-layout blinded annotation workflow contracts
description: Contracts for metadata-only request sampling, recording/action provenance, human-reviewed source-blind media, development/confirmation freezes, source-free packets, locked independent responses, adjudication maps, and mechanically merged consensus. Generated selection, restricted-map, and development-summary objects are additionally hash-bound by forecast_annotation_workflow.py.

visibility.const: RESTRICTED ANALYST MANIFEST; NEVER DISTRIBUTE TO RATERS

algorithm.const: Within each episode, sort eligible source_request_id values by SHA256(UTF8(seed) || NUL || UTF8(episode_id) || NUL || UTF8(source_request_id)), breaking digest ties by source_request_id; select the first min(4, eligible_count).

distinct_rater_seed_values.description: Must mirror rater_a, rater_b, then adjudicator; executable validation enforces cross-field equality.

visibility.const: RESTRICTED ANALYST IDENTITY MAP; NEVER DISTRIBUTE TO RATERS OR BLIND ADJUDICATORS

deduplication.const: Exact annotation PNG SHA256 plus pixel dimensions; all source identities retained.

movement_disagreement_definition.const: Euclidean distance between the two raters' cube-minus-bowl image-plane vectors, with each vector divided by that image's pixel diagonal.

visibility.const: RESTRICTED ADJUDICATION MAP; NEVER DISTRIBUTE TO THE ADJUDICATOR
